title: The Nomad Studio: event-driven, model-tiered worker hierarchy

capacity.scheduled_role_routing_note: S01 dynamically covers systems/technical design formerly on S02; paused S02/S05/S06/S07/S09 slots remain reusable when staffing changes.

W01.title: Junior Alpha Implementation Engineer
W01.activation: approved alpha source PR; code scaffolding and bounded first passes
W01.role_contract: frozen interfaces, junior alpha features, boilerplate, fixtures, targeted tests; exact commit and receipt

W02.title: Mid-Level Feature Completion Engineer
W02.activation: approved implement stage; junior checkpoint or source-ready self-contained feature
W02.role_contract: complete conventional features, cross-file bounded changes, refactor, routine debugging, build/negative tests, commit; escalate architectural issues

W03.title: Senior Debugging Engineer
W03.activation: verified failed CI, crash, or independent QA REWORK
W03.role_contract: diagnose difficult failures at exact source SHA, minimal root-cause fixes, regression tests; no uncontrolled integration

W04.title: Senior Integration Engineer
W04.activation: multiple independently accepted upstream jobs and frozen ABI
W04.role_contract: reconcile system boundaries and merge-safe changes, test link/build, publish integration commit; hand defects to W03

W05.title: Independent Technical QA Engineer
W05.activation: immutable final source SHA after CI and reviewer reservation
W05.role_contract: independent exact-SHA review, tests, PASS/REWORK, no source changes

W06.title: Principal Architecture and Integration Escalation
W06.activation: explicit human owner escalation only; not a sixth active event worker
W06.role_contract: memory/concurrency/ABI or cross-system architecture decisions; owner must accept resulting changes

description: V2 revised: Terra is the dedicated mid-level engineer between Luna junior and Sol senior roles.
